H1 2026 revenue KRW 2,178,313M (+13.4% YoY vs KRW 1,920,887M), operating profit KRW 545,304M (+27.6% YoY vs KRW 427,321M; 25.0% margin), net income KRW 413,828M (+40.1% YoY), EPS KRW 11,521. H1 mix: power equipment (transformers, HV circuit breakers) KRW 1,476,122M (67.8%), rotating machines KRW 351,638M (16.1%), distribution equipment etc. KRW 350,553M (16.1%). Exports KRW 1,706,656M = 78% of H1 sales (domestic KRW 471,657M). Filing cites continuing large-scale power-equipment capex from the power-hungry AI industry, DATA CENTERS and SEMICONDUCTOR FAB construction; North American demand surging from grid-replacement plus new grid build-out for data-center connections, expected to keep rising with AI-driven IDC expansion.

quarterly_data.signal: New products, R&D and corporate events (H1 2026): ESS track record >1.6GWh cumulative; 200MWh Texas Rutile BESS EPC (awarded 2025 by Korea Southern Power, executed via HD Hyundai Electric Texas LLC) and the 600MWh Anjwa ESS (1st central contract market; construction started early 2026, only awardee targeting completion within 2026); filing expects ESS demand to persist on AI/data-center-driven grid volatility. CEMS (Cloud Energy Management System) deployments at HD Hyundai Heavy Industries Ulsan (contract 2026-05) and HD Construction Equipment Ulsan (contract 2026-03), to be sold to external customers as SaaS. Eco portfolio (GREENTRIC): ester-oil transformers and SF6-free HV circuit breakers completed; SF6-free 170kV 50kA GIS certified; UL/cUL obtained for 4 MV/LV breaker types for North America; DC breakers and large DC distribution systems developed. R&D pipeline: UL ACB for renewables (2026-02-11 to 2026-06-30, US sales), MW-class grid-forming inverter controller with Seoul National University (2026-01-01 to 2026-12-31), AI-agent energy-efficiency diagnostics (to 2026-12-31), ship propulsion VFD engineering, transformer core/winding resonance modelling; H1 R&D spend KRW 49,284M (2.3% of sales). Yongin reliability-center real estate bought from HD Hyundai Oilbank for KRW 79,524M (closed 2025-11-17). EY-Parthenon study on US DTB/GIS market entry (2025-04). Credit rating upgraded to AA- (Korea Investors Service and NICE 2026-03-23, Korea Ratings 2026-03-25) from A+. Risks: KEPCO 170kV GIS collusion case (KRW 6.699B fine under appeal, 6-month KEPCO bid ban 2025-07-25 to 2026-01-24 stayed by court, next hearing 2026-09-18; KEPCO damages suit KRW 2.0B); US tariff regime and Middle East uncertainty flagged. EGM 2026-09-08 to elect independent director Kim Woo-chan after Han Chan-sik resigned 2026-06-21.
quarterly_data.figure: ESS >1.6GWh cumulative; 600MWh Anjwa + 200MWh Texas BESS under way; rating AA- (2026-03); R&D KRW 49.3B (2.3% of sales)
